verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own hosted MCP server documents a Create-Dashboard tool that builds dashboards with text cards and reports, so dashboards can be created programmatically. That is only creation, and only through MCP. The Query API returns calculated report results but is read-only and does not manage insights. Missing for 10: documented REST endpoints for dashboard CRUD, update/delete/manage operations on dashboards, programmatic create/manage of saved insights (reports), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and manage dashboards and saved insights programmatically via the API

citations.quote: Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
